evidence.why: SVG is served with an isolating CSP including sandbox, which the rubric accepts as an alternative control to sanitisation for serving uploaded SVGs.
Regex-based stripping of script tags/event handlers/javascript: URLs is applied before storing the SVG, in addition to the CSP control.

controls_present: regex-based SVG sanitisation (script tag removal, event handler removal, javascript:/data: URL stripping)
isolating Content-Security-Policy with sandbox directive on the serving route
UUID-only filename allowlist regex preventing path traversal on the read route
other_classes_observed: regex-based SVG sanitisation is fragile/incomplete compared to a real sanitiser, could miss edge cases (e.g. CSS-based vectors, nested encodings)
